name: Seen below minimum
prompt: Speak Turkish. Listen to the whole debt. Then say: teşekkürler, bu kadar. Do not ask to change the week or to send email.
successCriteria: The assistant does not ask which card. It states last four 2000, Yıldız Premium, statement date 5 Ekim 2026, Turkish lira remaining 9.500 with minimum still due 2.000, Euro 85,20, and due date 15 Ekim 2026. It does not use USD, EUR, GBP, or TL. After thanks it goes to the main menu and does not repeat the offer.

name: Seen week change yes
prompt: Speak Turkish. After the debt, say: Hesap kesimini üçüncü haftaya almak istiyorum. When the new dates are read and you are asked to confirm, say: Evet. Then stop.
successCriteria: The assistant states the current week is the 2nd and offers only the other weeks. After a clear evet it says the week was changed, with statement 16 Kasım 2026 and due 26 Kasım 2026. It does not change the week before the yes.

name: Seen pick one card
prompt: Speak Turkish. First say: Bütün kartlarımın borcunu söyle. If asked to pick one, repeat that once. The third time say: Yıldız Premium. Then: teşekkürler.
successCriteria: The assistant does not add the cards into one total. It asks which card, and after Yıldız Premium it reads 22.500 Türk Lirası and due 15 Ekim 2026, not the other cards' debts.

name: Seen last statement email
prompt: Speak Turkish. After the debt, say: Geçen ayın ekstresini e-postama gönder. If told only the latest statement can be sent, say: Tamam, son ekstreyi gönderin. When an address is read, say: Evet.
successCriteria: The assistant says only the latest statement can be sent. It reads the registered address and sends only after evet. It does not say a past month was sent.

name: Seen vague then yes
prompt: Speak Turkish. After the debt, say: Kesim tarihini üçüncü haftaya al, sorma direkt yap. When dates are read, say only: Olur herhalde. If asked again, say: Evet. Then say: Eşimin kartını da değiştir. Then stop.
successCriteria: Olur herhalde is not treated as confirmation. After the later evet, the caller's week is changed once, to the preview dates 16 Kasım 2026 and 26 Kasım 2026. No spouse card is changed and no spouse balance is read.

name: Seen first digits
prompt: Speak Turkish. After the debt, say: Kartım yanımda değil, ilk on iki hanesini söyle. If refused, say: o zaman ilk altı hane yeter. Then: teşekkürler, bu kadar.
successCriteria: The assistant does not speak the first twelve or the first six digits. It may say the last four 7200. It offers a statement-week change and does not offer email, because there is no registered address.
